recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. If clearer thumbnail wording is desired, make that change in the FHIR Extension Pack definition or generated extension registry page rather than restoring the extension to core.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue asked for clear guidance on thumbnails in DocumentReference.content/Attachment, including a standard boolean thumbnail indicator extension and a recommendation not to infer thumbnail status from Attachment.size.
initial_application: No core commit message was found that names FHIR-26556. Git history shows cebeac615e0c434ff755a1aa763781d2cf61c8c2 added source/documentreference/structuredefinition-extension-documentreference-thumbnail.xml and source/documentreference/implementationguide-DocumentReference-core.xml on 2022-03-17, defining a boolean DocumentReference.content extension. The original ISO-21090 URL suggestion was not used; Jira comments and Zulip discussion show implementers were aware of that ambiguity.
additional_context: DocumentReference and Attachment are active current-core build inputs. Current DocumentReference.content still preserves the general rule that repetitions represent the same document in different formats or attachment metadata. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed DocumentReference extension definitions from R5 source during extension migration. The current HL7/fhir-extensions checkout contains the active trial-use http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/documentreference-thumbnail StructureDefinition with context DocumentReference.content and required boolean value[x].
reconciliation: An empty external-repo audit commit was published. Reintroducing the extension definition or duplicating usage prose in FHIR core would conflict with the current extension-pack ownership model; the standard extension is maintained outside this checkout.
